exceptions.reason: ReDoS from a crafted extglob pattern. picomatch is reached only through the private webui's build tools (vite, @vitejs/plugin-react, json-schema-to-typescript), which run at build time on our own fixed patterns and are not in the published package; `npm audit --omit=dev` is clean. Every picomatch release up to 4.0.7 is affected and none is patched. Owner accepted 2026-11-18 to ship 1.55.0; remove when picomatch ships a fix.
